author: Marrie Pauza
description:
Fantasy Sapphire Clipart Bundle | Royal Blue Fairytale PNG Collection | Celestial Fantasy Ephemera | Gothic Princess Clip Art Set | Vintage Magical Kingdom Illustrations
WHAT YOU WILL RECEIVE
20 individual clipart illustrations

PNG format

Transparent background
Instant digital download
Commercial use included
This Fantasy Sapphire Clipart Bundle includes 20 luxurious royal fantasy illustrations inspired by enchanted kingdoms, celestial fairytales, antique gothic elegance, and magical storybook aesthetics.
The collection features sapphire castles, fantasy thrones, royal crowns, celestial butterflies, ornate mirrors, moonlit florals, jeweled peacocks, stained glass windows, magical keys, chandeliers, perfume bottles, treasure chests, fantasy dragons, swans, moths, carriages, crystal lanterns, and other elegant fantasy kingdom elements.
Each illustration is created in a soft painterly vintage fantasy style with richly decorative detailing, glowing sapphire gemstones, ornate silver filigree, celestial moon motifs, and whimsical aristocratic elegance. The artwork is isolated on clean transparent backgrounds, making the collection highly versatile for digital and physical creative projects.
The luxurious color palette features deep sapphire blue, antique ivory, icy silver, pearl white, moonlit cobalt, and smoky navy tones inspired by royal fantasy kingdoms and enchanted celestial worlds.
